title.rendered: San Rafael Bar Mitzvah DJ – Community Center – Ben Chair Hava Nagila February 15th 2014

content.rendered:
We are Professional Bar and Bat Mitzvah DJs and we get everyone up to join in the Fun.

The Hora noone sits down

Bar Mitzvah – The Chair

 

Games/ Dances – Balloon Pass, Fuzzy Dice,  Freeze Dance, YMCA, Footloose, Electric Slide.
 6  blue uplights for the room.
Ben has some requests: No Coke/Pepsi game.

Music:

Ben has another song to add to his list..
Push Play by Zedd feat. Miriam Bryant – his favorite song
I Cry
Titanium
Treasure
Couldn’t Hold Us
Clarity
Give it 2 U
Gorrilla
Roar
Lights
Whistle
Feel So Close
Glad You Came
Starships
We Found Love
Good Feeling
Applause
Thrift Shop
Don’t you Worry Child
I will Follow you into the Dark
Moves Like Jagger
Mr. Saxobeat
Grenade
Firework
Allstar – Smashmouth
Airplanes – B.O.B.
Rough Water – Travi McCoy
Demons – Imagine Dragons
Timber – Pitbull
Monster – Eminem
Pompei – Bastille
All the Right Moves – One Republic
Feel this Moment
We are Family
Stereo Hearts during Dinner
Same Love – Dinner
 70’s and 80’s dance tunes  for us “older” kids.  In addition, we would like to do the traditional Hora and we will be doing a Havdallah Service for which we will need to use the microphone for a few minutes.
